name: DitLead
description_en:
DitLead documents a multichannel sequence builder with waits, conditions, webhooks and per-step ownership. Its AI assists with campaign content and variants, while the team handles conversations. Provider examples and performance figures are illustrative marketing, not results measured by this catalog. The free tier and paid plans have materially different channel and credit allowances.

An example pilot could send an introduction, wait for a reply, then use a LinkedIn or call branch only when appropriate. The builder documents AND/OR conditions, variants and automatic cross-channel pause when a response arrives. Review queued actions after a response and before manual re-enrollment; the advertised pause behavior was not tested here. Establish sender permissions, opt-out handling and a person responsible for replies before launching.
description_zh:
DitLead 的文档描述多渠道序列构建器，包含等待、条件、webhook 与步骤归属。AI 协助生成活动内容及变体，团队负责会话。厂商示例与表现数字属于营销说明，不是本目录实测结果。免费层与付费套餐的渠道和额度范围有明显差别。

试点可安排介绍邮件，等待回复后再按条件进入 LinkedIn 或电话分支。构建器记录了 AND/OR 条件、变体，以及收到回应时跨渠道自动暂停。回复后与手工重新加入序列前，应检查排队动作；本次未实测宣传的暂停行为。启动前应明确发送权限、退订处理与回复负责人。

Review queued actions after a response and before manual re-enrollment; the advertised pause behavior was not tested here. items.en: Team is where the visible plan starts including email, LinkedIn and calling together; Popular adds API/webhooks and more accounts. A simple email process may not need these tiers. “Unlimited” sending does not establish mailbox-provider capacity or delivery guarantees. The service runs through an online account; self-hosting and source licensing were not verified. Validate bounce handling, account restrictions and re-enrollment with representative records before scaling beyond a small pilot.
items.zh: 可见套餐从 Team 开始把邮件、LinkedIn 与电话放在一起；Popular 增加 API/webhook 及更多账户。简单邮件流程未必需要这些等级。“无限”发送不能证明邮箱供应商容量或送达保证。服务通过在线账户运行，尚未确认自托管与源代码许可。扩大试点前，应使用代表性记录验证退信、账户限制与重新入序行为。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The free plan lists 200 contacts, 1,000 emails/month, one email account and 100 lead credits. Annual prices shown are Starter $31/month ($372/year), Team $82 ($984/year), and Popular $125 ($1,500/year). Paid sending is advertised as unlimited, but verification uses one credit, a lead reveal five, and Auto Outreach email research fifteen. Paid trials last seven days and require a card; they are separate from the no-card free tier. Extra LinkedIn accounts and infrastructure can add charges.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费版列出 200 联系人、每月 1,000 封邮件、一个邮箱及 100 线索额度。页面年付折算价为 Starter 每月 31 美元（每年 372）、Team 82（每年 984）、Popular 125（每年 1,500）。付费发送宣传为无限，但验证每次一额度、揭示线索五额度、Auto Outreach 邮件研究十五额度。付费试用为七天且需信用卡，与免卡免费层不同。额外 LinkedIn 账户与基础设施可能另收费。
